# Copilot Instructions
- Core entrypoint is [src/main.rs](src/main.rs): Axum 0.7 server, WebSocket chat, room routing, and background maintenance tasks. Tests live in [src/tests.rs](src/tests.rs) and mirror most behaviors.
- Static client lives in [index.html](index.html): plain JS connects to `ws(s)://host/ws/{room}`, renders messages/typing/read receipts, and sends JSON `{type:"Message"|"Typing"|"ReadReceipt", ...}` payloads.
- HTTP routes: `/` redirects to `/main`; `/main` serves the bundled HTML; `/:room` validates names (length 3–50, regex `^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-_]*[a-zA-Z0-9]$`, rejects reserved paths like `robots.txt`, `main`, `admin`, `api`); `/ws/:room` upgrades to WebSocket after validation; `/robots.txt` is generated in handler.
- App state: `AppState` holds a rooms map plus resource monitors (`ResourceMonitor`, `MemoryTracker`, `ConnectionPool`, `SecurityManager`). Each room is a `RoomState` with `broadcast::Sender`, `chat_history`, `users`, `available_animals`, memory counters, and timestamps.
- Users: `UserData` tracks `user_id`, `animal_name`, `connection_state`, rate limiting, typing, last read, and last sanitized message. Cookies `user_id` and `animal_name` are created in `create_user_cookies` and re-used via `UserCookie` extractor (HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, Secure).
- Message flow: on WS connect, user is assigned/reused, history is replayed, `OutgoingEvent::ReconnectToken` is sent, then tasks run for forwarding broadcasts, receiving client events, ping heartbeats, and heartbeat messages to clients.
- Sanitization and formatting: `validate_message` enforces non-empty and max length; inbound text is rendered through Comrak Markdown then cleaned with Ammonia before broadcast. Duplicate messages within `SANITIZE_TIMEOUT` are ignored. Room names also pass `validate_input`.
- Limits and safety: multiple constants gate behavior (e.g., `MAX_MESSAGES_PER_WINDOW`, `MAX_CONCURRENT_CONNECTIONS_PER_IP`, `MAX_MESSAGES_PER_ROOM`, `MAX_TOTAL_ROOMS_MEMORY`, `MAX_MESSAGE_LEN`, `MESSAGE_RATE_LIMIT`, heartbeat/reconnect timeouts). Respect these when adding features; use existing helpers (`RateLimiter`, `MemoryTracker`, `ConnectionPool`, `SecurityManager`) instead of ad-hoc checks.
- Cleanup: background tasks trim rooms/messages (`cleanup_rooms`, `RoomState::trigger_cleanup`, `RoomState::cleanup_messages`, `RoomState::cleanup_users`) and GC memory every minute/hour. Main Ctrl-C handler calls `shutdown`/`graceful_shutdown` to broadcast server shutdown events.
- Events: server emits `OutgoingEvent::{Message,System,UserCount,Heartbeat,ReconnectToken}`; system events include joins/leaves/typing/read receipts/shutdown. Client sends `ClientEvent::{Message,Typing,ReadReceipt}`; keep enums/tagged serde names stable for compatibility.
- Frontend expectations: messages include `message_id`, `animal_name`, `text` (already sanitized HTML), and `timestamp` (ms). Client auto-plays a sound on received messages and marks read receipts when scrolled to bottom.
- Logging/telemetry: tracing is configured via `tracing_subscriber::fmt::init()`; prefer `info!/warn!/error!/debug!` already in use. Metrics crates are present but not wired; avoid adding new logging frameworks.
- Build/run: default `PORT` 3000; run locally with `cargo run --release` (or `cargo run`). Tests: `cargo test` (note some WebSocket tests rely on upgrade status and may need network availability). Binary name from Cargo is `infinite-chat` (used by [Procfile](Procfile)); align `heroku.yml` run command if changing binary name.
- Deployment hints: server binds `0.0.0.0:PORT`; Procfile/heroku.yml imply Heroku container deploy. Ensure release build output path matches process definitions before shipping.
- Conventions when extending: reuse room/user helpers (e.g., `RoomState::assign_animal`, `RoomState::broadcast_user_count`, `RoomState::broadcast_system_event`) and avoid locking patterns that would hold write locks across await points except where already done.
- Security posture: IP bans/connection caps via `SecurityManager`/`ConnectionPool`; keep new endpoints behind similar validation. Message HTML is already sanitized server-side; avoid bypassing `validate_message` or `ammonia`/Markdown pipeline.
- UX copy: instructions and branding live inline in [index.html](index.html); keep tone consistent with the “social art experiment” framing.
- Static assets: `robots.txt` is generated dynamically in handler, not from the root file; if you change crawl policy, update both [src/main.rs](src/main.rs) handler and [robots.txt](robots.txt) to stay in sync.
